description: Election Commission - Declare that U. G. R. Gamage as a member of the Polonnaruwa Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local municipal council due to a member's failure to attend meetings, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, candidate nomination by a political party, and a formal declaration of a newly elected member by the Returning Officer. This content fits squarely within the definition of "Elections Gazettes" (Type 7), which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
